odd.dialogue.chat: The door said you'd come. The door is never wrong twice. Speak, %1$s.
odd.dialogue.chat/1: The bucket said you'd stop by, and the bucket keeps good time. Speak, I'm listening — so is the bucket.
odd.dialogue.chat/2: Ah, you. The candles flickered a welcome. Sit where the floor doesn't creak accusingly, %1$s.
odd.dialogue.conversations: You want to talk? The fence and I just finished. Your timing is excellent. Ask anything — I've already told the bucket.
odd.dialogue.conversations/1: Talk! Yes. I've warmed up on the bucket, so my words are the right temperature now. Go on, %1$s.
odd.dialogue.conversations/2: The spoons rearranged themselves into a listening shape this morning. They knew. Ask away.
odd.dialogue.conversations.checkin.good: The bees hummed in E this week, which means luck. Also I found my other spoon. So: thriving, thank you for asking.
odd.dialogue.conversations.checkin.good/: Good — the moths flew clockwise, which is the lucky direction. Also I have both socks. A rich week.
Thriving. The well echoed twice this morning, and two is the number for yes. I trust the well, %1$s.
odd.dialogue.conversations.checkin.rough: The door has been sticking, and doors know things. It's been a heavy week, %1$s. The door agrees with me.
The hinges have been sighing, and hinges are honest. A heavy week. Even the cat's been philosophical.
odd.dialogue.conversations.checkin.again: You've asked before — the bucket remembers. The answer hasn't changed shape yet, %1$s. These things ripen slowly.
Twice! The candles noticed too. Still the same, still glad you count. The floorboards are warming to you.
odd.dialogue.conversations.day.good: A seventeen-cloud day. Those are the good ones. I told the well this morning and it echoed back, which is a yes.
odd.dialogue.conversations.day.good/1: A twelve-bird morning and a cloud shaped like forgiveness. The signs are all pointing gentle today.
odd.dialogue.conversations.day.rough: The bread came out shaped like the mayor. I ate it anyway, but we were both uncomfortable about it.
odd.dialogue.conversations.day.rough/1: The porridge whispered something rude and I've been off-balance since. Some days start on the wrong omen, %1$s.
odd.dialogue.conversations.work.like: The work likes me, which matters more. Tools remember gentle hands. Mine remember me back — except the hammer. We're quarreling.
odd.dialogue.conversations.work.like/1: The tools and I have an understanding. All but the hammer — we're in a silent feud, and I intend to win it.
odd.dialogue.conversations.work.hate: I asked my boots whether I like the job. They said we walk there slower every year. Boots can't lie. No mouths.
odd.dialogue.conversations.work.hate/1: My boots say we go slower each year, and boots don't lie — no mouths to lie WITH. So: mixed feelings.
odd.dialogue.conversations.village.home: %2$s sits at exactly the right angle to the sunset, which is why the bread rises here and nowhere else. Home, obviously.
odd.dialogue.conversations.village.home/: I know which stones in %2$s are listening and which are just resting. It's a good village. The well vouches for it.
odd.dialogue.conversations.people.first: Good folk. I've assigned each of them a cloud. The mayor's is stubborn; the baker's is warm. It's a whole system, %1$s.
odd.dialogue.conversations.people.first/: The neighbors are lovely once you learn their weathers. Some are drizzle, some are noon. All are welcome at my fence.
odd.dialogue.conversations.food.first: Whatever the bucket recommends. Today it said turnips, but the bucket has an agenda. I'm having bread instead.
odd.dialogue.conversations.food.first/1: Soup, if it's the right shape in the bowl. Round is calm, oval is ambitious. I eat by the omens, %1$s.
odd.dialogue.conversations.life.first: Born on a Tuesday, which explains a lot. A flood, a goose I still owe an apology, one summer I keep in a jar. I'll start with the goose.
odd.dialogue.conversations.life.first/1: It began on a Tuesday and never fully recovered. There's a goose I wronged and a summer in a jar. Where to start...
odd.dialogue.conversations.dreams.first: I dream of a staircase that goes sideways, into a room where everyone I ever fed is fine. The chickens agree it's real.
odd.dialogue.conversations.dreams.first/: A sideways staircase to a warm room where everyone I ever fed is safe. The chickens have confirmed it's real.
odd.dialogue.conversations.fears.first: The gap between thunder and thunder — that's when the sky decides. And that only the bucket would miss me. ...Silly. Probably.
odd.dialogue.conversations.fears.first/1: The silence between two thunderclaps — that's when the sky is deciding. And being missed only by the bucket.
odd.dialogue.conversations.feelings.firs: The candles burn straighter when you're here, %1$s. I checked three times. You make the room make sense. Don't tell the candles.
You arrive and the candles stand up straighter. I've measured it, %1$s. You make the room agree with itself.
odd.dialogue.conversations.deflect.perso: That answer lives under the third floorboard, and the floorboard doesn't know you yet. Come by more. Floorboards warm up. So do I.
That one's filed somewhere I'd have to move furniture to reach. Come back when you've been about longer and I'll shift the wardrobe.
odd.dialogue.conversations.deflect.intim: That one I've only ever told the well, and the well earned it over years. Keep coming around, %1$s. You're getting well-shaped.
Only the well knows that one, and it took years to earn it. Keep coming round — you're getting well-shaped, %1$s.
odd.dialogue.conversations.gossip.none: The weathervane hasn't moved in three days, which is either no news or very big news. I'm treating it as no news. Safer.
odd.dialogue.conversations.gossip.none/1: The weathervane's held still three days. Either nothing's happening or everything is. I've chosen to believe nothing. Calmer.
odd.dialogue.conversations.us.happy.yes: Happy? The candles burn straight, the well says yes twice, and my odd little world makes sense with you in it. So: yes.
odd.dialogue.conversations.us.happy.yes/: You're the one thing the omens and I agree on completely, %1$s. That's never happened before. Yes. Yes.
odd.dialogue.conversations.gossip.marria: %2$s and %3$s got married, and the bells rang in a key I'd never heard before — a good key, the well confirmed it.
%2$s wed %3$s under a cloud shaped like a knot, which is the marrying cloud. The bucket wept, happily I think.
odd.dialogue.conversations.gossip.divorc: %2$s and %3$s parted ways. The weathervane spun twice and stopped facing nowhere in particular. These things happen.
%2$s and %3$s aren't together anymore. Two spoons that used to nest now sit apart in my drawer. They knew before I did.
odd.dialogue.conversations.gossip.death: %2$s has passed on, %1$s. The candles all leaned toward their house last night, saying goodbye in the only way candles can.
odd.dialogue.conversations.gossip.death/: We lost %2$s. The well echoed once this morning, and one is the number for farewell. I'll miss them terribly.
odd.dialogue.conversations.gossip.birth: A baby! %2$s brought a new little one into the world, and the chickens have been clucking lullabies all day.
odd.dialogue.conversations.gossip.birth/: %2$s had a baby, %1$s! I've already assigned the child a cloud — a soft, round, brand-new one. Welcome, little cloud.
odd.dialogue.conversations.gossip.arriva: %2$s has moved into the village. The floorboards by their new door are still learning their footsteps, but they'll warm up.
Someone new — %2$s! The fence introduced us. I've decided they're a noon sort of person, which is a fine sort to be.
odd.dialogue.conversations.gossip.depart: %2$s packed up and left for good. Their empty chair is holding their shape for now; chairs are loyal like that.
%2$s has gone away, %1$s. I keep setting out one too many turnips. The habit hasn't heard the news yet.
odd.dialogue.chatmode.confused: The words arrived in the wrong order. Resend them?
odd.dialogue.chatmode.confused/1: Hm. The bees didn't understand that either.
odd.dialogue.chatmode.hint: Ask about %2$s. The mushrooms recommend it.
odd.dialogue.chatmode.hint/1: %2$s — all fine topics. The third one hums, though.
odd.dialogue.chatmode.shrug: The answer exists. Just not near me.
odd.dialogue.chatmode.clarify: %2$s or %3$s? The frog says %2$s, but frogs lie.
odd.dialogue.chatmode.clarify/1: One of them: %2$s, %3$s. Choose before the moon notices.
odd.dialogue.chatmode.dropped: Poof. The topic has left its body.
odd.dialogue.chatmode.busy: Currently negotiating with a very stubborn root. One moment.
odd.dialogue.chatmode.busy/1: Busy — the pigeons demand a recount.
odd.dialogue.chatmode.muted: Sealed. The silence has a lovely texture, doesn't it?
odd.dialogue.chatmode.muted/1: Shh. *nods to no one* We're quiet now.
odd.dialogue.chatmode.farewell: Goodbye, %1$s. Walk only on the friendly cobbles.
odd.dialogue.chatmode.farewell/1: Off you drift. Tell the horizon I said hello.
odd.dialogue.chatmode.insult: The wind will file that under 'rude'. It keeps records, you know.
odd.dialogue.chatmode.insult/1: Curious. The same words the chickens use.
odd.dialogue.chatmode.hail: %1$s! The morning said you'd come. The morning is rarely wrong.
odd.dialogue.chatmode.hail/1: Ah, %1$s. You're realer than usual today.
odd.dialogue.chatmode.hail/2: *waves with the wrong hand* Hello hello.
odd.dialogue.chatmode.hail_cold: Hm. The shadows arrived first. They usually do.
odd.dialogue.chatmode.attentive: Yes? Speak — the snails are listening too.
odd.dialogue.chatmode.attentive/1: You rang the air. Here I am.
odd.dialogue.conversations.day.rough.emp: It is. Days have a texture and today's is wrong, and you're the first to accept that as a sentence.
odd.dialogue.conversations.checkin.rough: The wood, then. Tuesday. I'll have thought of a system by then. I always think of a system.
odd.dialogue.conversations.work.followup: ...It is! Nobody asks about the wearing. They ask about the finishing. Fascinating that you didn't.
odd.dialogue.conversations.fears.open.pl: You'll stand with me. Right. I'm putting that in the same drawer as the other important things.
odd.dialogue.conversations.hopes.respond: You waited. People don't wait. They fill. You just... didn't. I've been thinking about it.
odd.dialogue.conversations.life.revisit: You asked about my life once and I've since remembered eleven things I forgot to mention.
